story.title: Your stay in the heart of Chefchaouen
story.body: Discover Chefchaouen from a welcoming, ideally located place. Enjoy our 13 rooms, our Moroccan hospitality and a prime location for exploring the blue city and the Rif mountains.
story.access: Just a 5-minute walk from the bus station, and easy to reach by car or van.

story.photo2Alt: The guesthouse's blue door on the terrace

sections.title: Your home in the heart of Chefchaouen
paragraphs: Opened in 2022, AFASSI Guesthouse welcomes travellers in a warm and friendly setting, offering a comfortable stay in the heart of Chefchaouen, Morocco's famous blue city.
Classified in the second category, our guesthouse has 13 rooms designed to give our visitors comfort and peace.

Thanks to its ideal position in the town centre, AFASSI Guesthouse is only a 5-minute walk from the bus station and about 10 minutes from the old Medina. It is also easy to reach by car or van, which makes arriving simple whatever way you travel.

sections.title: Hospitality, comfort and personalised service
paragraphs: At AFASSI Guesthouse, we believe hospitality is more than offering a comfortable room. Above all it rests on the welcome, the attention given to each visitor and the pleasure of sharing the generosity of Moroccan hospitality.
Our team does everything it can to give you a quality service, with a concierge service and personal assistance throughout your stay.

Whether you want advice on places to visit, help organising your activities or an introduction to the region's character, our team is always available to look after you and make your stay as pleasant as possible.
For travellers discovering Morocco by motorcycle, we also provide a closed, free-of-charge garage for motorcycles, so they can enjoy their stay with peace of mind.

sections.title: Discover Chefchaouen and its surroundings
paragraphs: Chefchaouen is much more than its famous blue alleys. Surrounded by the magnificent Rif mountains, the region offers a wide range of experiences, from cultural discoveries and local traditions to natural landscapes and outdoor adventure.
At AFASSI Guesthouse, we want to show you the best of our destination. That is why we organise excursions and visits, both in the heart of the town and in the surrounding regions.
Whether you want to wander the alleys of the old Medina, explore the region's natural landscapes or discover the local culture, we are here to help you make the most of your stay.
